name: digi
description: A digi companion that floats in your Claude Code session, reacts to how it is going and talks back

view.title: View
view.description: "float": it floats over the session and you drag it anywhere. "widget": a sharper drawing with the glow and colour split, in a corner widget of the desktop app, which cannot be dragged. The /digi float and /digi widget commands switch it too.

claudeVoice.title: Claude writes its lines
claudeVoice.description: On: a small Claude model speaks for your digi, on your own plan. Off: it only uses its stock phrases.

sessionComments.title: Comments on your session
sessionComments.description: On: its lines can mention how the session is going: turns, tool calls, failures and the last thing you typed.
